# zabbix_proxygroup (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the proxy group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the proxy group.
- `failover_delay` (String) Proxy group failover delay. Accepts seconds or time unit with suffix (e.g., 30s, 5m, 1h).
- `min_online` (Number) Minimum number of online proxies needed to consider the group available.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
